AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Poultry Rearing in a Fold and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Pest and Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Animal Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
